title: Cold rebuild: count to for_each
summary: Migrate a counted resource to for_each and remove an item without rebuilding the others, from memory.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: In *count, for_each and the index-shift trap* you moved three site configs from `count` to `for_each` and removed the
blog without touching docs or shop. Do it again from memory: **no hints, no solution**, the same checks (they compare
the files' modification times, so a rebuild is caught).

steps.title: Move to for_each, then remove the blog, cold
prompt: In `~/infra/sites`, switch `local_file.site` from `count` to `for_each` over the site names, remove `"blog"`, and
apply. Only the blog's file may be destroyed; docs and shop must not be rewritten. The plan ends clean.
From memory: no hints this time.
